question: Which option best captures the cultural importance of the Kanuma festival celebrated in Andhra Pradesh?

options.text: Observance linked to forest conservation rituals
Festival devoted to worshipping agricultural cattle
Celebration marking the end of winter solstice

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Festival devoted to worshipping agricultural cattle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanuma** festival is an important part of the celebrations during the **Sankranti festival** in **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It is a day specifically devoted to **worshipping agricultural cattle**, such as cows, bulls, and oxen.
 
• The festival signifies the critical role of cattle in **agriculture and rural livelihoods**.
 
• Farmers and rural communities express their gratitude to cattle, acknowledging their contribution to **ploughing fields** and other agricultural activities.
 
• On Kanuma, cattle are cleaned, decorated with **flowers and turmeric**, and sometimes painted with natural colors as a sign of celebration.
 
• Special rituals and offerings are made to honor the cattle, reflecting the importance of **traditional agrarian practices**.
 
• Kanuma is part of the larger Sankranti celebrations, which include **Pongal and Bhogi**, focusing on themes of **harvest, gratitude, and renewal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Observance linked to forest conservation rituals**__

 __
 
• Forest conservation rituals typically focus on **preserving biodiversity** and ensuring the sustainable use of forest resources.
 
• These types of rituals are observed in various parts of India but are not a central theme of the **Kanuma festival**.
 
 
 
• **Event commemorating river goddesses**__
 __
 
• The worship of river goddesses is common in India, especially in festivals dedicated to sacred rivers such as the **Ganga, Yamuna, or Narmada**.
 
• While such rituals are significant, they are not related to the **Kanuma festival**, which is focused on cattle worship.
 
 
 
• **Celebration marking the end of winter solstice**__
 
 
• The winter solstice is associated with various festivals globally, often signifying the **return of longer days**.
 
• In India, the Sankranti festival as a whole marks the **transition of the sun into the zodiac sign of Capricorn (Makara)**, but Kanuma specifically focuses on cattle worship.
